First of all, today my bus from Butterworth came super late, then walking into the office is like entering Genting Highland because the aircon damn freezing cold, sibeh shivering until my fingers blur when typing. Then you know my SAP access only came late yesterday afternoon right? So blur like sotong trying to catch up with the high quota given to us this week, and my team lead also busy non-stop on calls. But not everything so jialak lah, at least this morning I tried the canteen nasi lemak and confirm nice, sambal sedap! But the main real issue actually is nobody gave me the vendor master rules yet, so invoices keep getting rejected by the system and I have to redo all of them from scratch again, totally wasting so much time, so if someone can guide me on these rules properly really can save me.
